priceScope: Central estimate withdrawn; conditional braking-policy mortality diagnostics

model.costScope: All recipient program, management and fundraising expenses; five-year constant-FY2024 cost cohort. Only prospective AEB mortality health is quantified. Not restricted AEB efficiency, not total social cost.
model.geographicAttribution: Domestic heavy-vehicle crash prevention. Central 99% of modeled health is assigned to residents of 50 states plus DC, allowing 1% nonresident road users. This is a judgment, not a measured residence share; foreign/territorial policy effects excluded.
model.formula: Fj(t)=min(cap, rate*max(0,t-Lj+1)); A=sum(t=1..T)[F1(t)-F0(t)]/(1.03^t). H=D*r*q*A. Q_all=b*(p*a*H-h); Q_USA=g*Q_all. Cost=C*Y; price=10*Cost/Q_USA when positive. For normalized support G, multiply both cohort cost and Q by G/(C*Y); no linear scaling claim beyond small marginal support.
model.counterfactual: Public agencies, manufacturers and other advocates continue. Both deployment paths ultimately converge; only acceleration is counted. D already removes pre-NPRM voluntary adoption; r allows subsequent erosion and transport. Existing donor/reserve/public substitution is represented by b.
model.attribution: Congress, agencies, manufacturers and multiple advocates continue absent the gift. Historical Road Safe America participation does not identify IST's future marginal role; do not double count merger entities or coalition effects. Alpha p=.15, a=.10 and b=.50 lack calibration and are diagnostic only.
model.uncertainty: Central withdrawn; no calibrated gift-sensitive policy acceleration, IST-specific contribution or funding capacity. Unknown is not zero. Retained alpha numerical inputs and scenarios are conditional diagnostics, not recommendation or confidence bounds.
model.nativeOutcomes: Reports, survivor resources and advocacy engagements are observed service categories, not health units. Model bridge uses residual risk-weighted fleet deployment, additional crash fatalities prevented, then discounted QALYs; no policy-win-to-QALY shortcut.

inputs.name: C
inputs.rationale: FY2024 total functional expenses; no separately netted direct-event, rental, gaming or inventory costs reported. All programs and overhead charged.

inputs.name: Y
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Five-year policy-support cohort priced at constant FY2024 annual scale; not a restricted AEB budget.

inputs.name: D
inputs.unit: annual fatalities prevented at completed AEB deployment
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Sourced regulatory forecast of 106 AEB fatalities prevented annually at full residual-fleet deployment; not observed deaths. Based on four test vehicles; baseline adoption/dark/weather already adjusted.

inputs.name: r
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Halve the 2023 AEB opportunity for subsequent voluntary uptake, narrower eventual rule, real-world transport and execution. Does not reapply all historical uptake already removed from D.

inputs.name: q
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Rounded mixed-age adult road-user expectation; approximately decades of future survival adjusted for quality and 3% discounting at time of death. Range 10–25; not the regulator's monetary fatal-equivalent metric.

inputs.name: L1
inputs.unit: first deployment year with successful acceleration
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Accounts for regulatory finalization plus new-vehicle compliance lead time; not a claim of a currently effective mandate.

inputs.name: L0
inputs.unit: first deployment year absent accelerated coalition effort
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Same eventual adoption but two years later; public agencies, manufacturers and other advocates continue in the counterfactual.

inputs.name: rate
inputs.unit: fraction of residual opportunity deployed / year
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Risk-weighted fleet replacement approximation; slower than immediate installation. Not observed current vehicle penetration.

inputs.name: cap
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Coverage is of the remaining D*r opportunity, not all trucks.

inputs.name: T
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Central deployment paths converge before year 25. The poor scenario converges in years 32–33, so its 25-year truncation omits later positive acceleration benefit; it is not a complete-duration lower bound.

inputs.name: discount
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Discount event-year benefits; q is separately discounted from event onward, not double discounting the same interval.

inputs.name: p
inputs.unit: probability of acceleration due to incremental coalition work
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Fifteen percent over five years recognizes pending statutory process and adverse policy climate. Not probability any rule ever passes. This is a subjective expected-value estimate, not identified causal likelihood.

inputs.name: a
inputs.unit: IST contribution conditional on coalition-enabled acceleration
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Ten percent recognizes experienced staff, survivor engagement and stated participation while reserving 90% for agencies, manufacturers and other advocates. No historical rule credited wholesale.

inputs.name: b
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Half allows reserves, donor substitution and staff capacity; current public evidence does not identify a funded-versus-unfunded workplan.

inputs.name: g
inputs.unit: share of modeled road-user QALYs accruing to 50-state/DC residents
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Domestic crash mechanism, with 1% allowance for nonresident road users. Not measured residence; test .95–1. No territorial or foreign regulatory effects credited.

inputs.name: h
inputs.unit: other net health harm over five-year cohort, before b and g
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Other portfolio branches and technology-induced harm set net zero centrally; not proven zero or a lower bound. Negative outcomes included in sensitivity.

inputs.name: deploymentPaths
inputs.rationale: Retained alpha diagnostic, not beta central. Inspectable central paths, F1/F0. Multiplication by D*r yields averted-death opportunity; neither advocacy contacts nor report downloads enter health arithmetic.
